title: Miller Industries Introduces the Century® M65 Rolling Rotator
summary: Current news and information related to Miller Industries products and services.
body_markdown:
## A New Approach to Rotator Recovery: The Century® M65


**Miller Industries** , the world's largest manufacturer of towing and recovery equipment, is proud to introduce the **Century® M65 Rolling Rotator** , a 65-ton recovery machine engineered to give operators greater reach, lifting performance, and flexibility for today's most demanding towing and recovery operations. Designed to perform recoveries from the rear, side, or front of the wrecker, the M65 delivers the versatility professional operators need when conditions are at their toughest.


At the core of the M65 is its innovative rolling turret, which travels more than seven feet along the body, allowing operators to reposition the boom without moving the truck. Combined with an outrigger stance exceeding 23 feet and a maximum boom height of more than 44 feet, the M65 provides an expansive 5,380-square-foot working area for greater recovery flexibility and jobsite efficiency.


The M65 backs its reach with serious power. Its three-stage boom is rated at 130,000 pounds when fully retracted and is paired with dual 50,000-pound, two-speed planetary main winches. A redesigned 30,000-pound planetary drag winch with reversible cable routing further enhances recovery capability, while optional turret winches provide additional pulling power when needed.


Every Century M65 comes standard with Miller Industries' patented **Raptor® Control System** , giving operators improved visibility of the recovery area along with real-time load-sensing information and enhanced lighting controls. Models equipped with an underlift also feature the new Gen 2 Flex12 Underlift Remote, providing full proportional control of the underlift, boom, boom travel, and winches.


“The M65 was built for the conditions our customers encounter every day, not simply to lead a spec-sheet comparison,” said Will Miller, President and CEO of Miller Industries. “Hundreds of people in engineering, R&D and manufacturing devoted thousands of hours to this program, creating the most advanced recovery machine Miller Industries has ever built.” The Century® M65 is now available through authorized Miller Industries distributors.


Visit[millerind.com/products/rotators/century-m65](https://millerind.com/products/rotators/century-m65) for more information.
